name: Office Ally
short_description: Healthcare clearinghouse for electronic insurance claims, eligibility checks and remittances, with a free web-based practice-management tool.
long_description: Office Ally's Service Center is a claims clearinghouse many self-billing therapists use, and several therapy EHRs route claims through it. Electronic claims to participating payers are free. If you submit any claim to a non-participating payer in a month, there is a $44.95 monthly fee per Tax ID and rendering NPI combination. Paper claims and eligibility checks cost extra. Practice Mate, a basic practice-management system, has no subscription fee. It is software, not a billing service: you still work denials and follow-up yourself.
one_liner: Near-free insurance claim submission for therapists who do their own billing.
best_for: Solo therapists who bill insurance themselves, mostly to participating payers
Clinicians whose EHR exports claims and who need a low-cost clearinghouse
Practices wanting free basic practice management alongside a clearinghouse
Billers comfortable checking payers' participating status
not_for: Clinicians who want someone else to handle billing, denials and follow-up
Practices billing many non-participating payers, where $44.95 per Tax ID + NPI each month adds up
Clinicians wanting a modern therapy EHR with notes and telehealth built in

notes.insurance-billing: A widely used clearinghouse: free electronic claims to participating payers, with ERA and eligibility checks.
notes.budget: Claims to participating payers cost nothing; a $44.95/month fee applies only in months you bill a non-participating payer.

transaction_fees.electronic_claims: Free to participating payers; $44.95/month per Tax ID + NPI if any non-participating payer is billed that month

pricing.notes: Fees from Office Ally's Service Center data sheet. Payers can change participating status, which changes fees.
